name: Login Block
description: Full login page with email/password form, remember me, and social auth.

props.name: title
props.description: Heading above the form. Example: title="Sign in"

props.name: subtitle
props.default: Enter your email to sign in to your account
props.description: Supporting line under the heading. Example: subtitle="Use your work email"

props.name: onSubmit

type.signature: (data: { email: string; password: string; remember: boolean }) => void

props.description: Called with the collected credentials when the form is submitted. Example: onSubmit={({ email, password }) => signIn(email, password)}

props.name: showSocial
props.description: Render the "Or continue with" social sign-in section. Example: showSocial={false}

props.name: className
props.description: CSS class names for the full-page wrapper. Example: className="bg-card"
